content: Iconium Theng
Iconium ah Paul le Barnabas te a ni in Judah te synagogue sungah paikhawm uh a, thuhil uh hi. Tabang in Judah mite le Greek mite mihon tampi in um uh hi.
Ahihang a um ngawl Judah mite in Gentile mite hanthawn uh a, a um suapui te langpan nopna thinsung phangawl nei tu in vawt uh hi.

Tua ahikom amate in Topa sungah hangsantak in thuhil uh a, hun saupi sung tam uh hi, tabang in Pathian hesuakna thu tettipanna atu in musakna te le nalamdang te amate khut tungtawn in vawt thei na pia hi.
Ahihang khuapi sung a om mihonpi te kikhen uh hi: pawlkhat te in Judah mite sang pang uh a, a dang pawlkhat te in sawltak te sang pang uh hi.
Gentile mite, Judah mite le lampui te in amate selno uh a, suangtum taw sep tu in a del uh ciang,
Amate in he uh a, Lycaonia ngamsung a om Lystra khua, Derbe khua le a kimlepam ngam te ah tai uh hi.
Taciang tua mun ah lungdamna thupha hil uh hi.
Peangbaipa Dam
Lystra ah a khealzaw, a nu sung pan a sua pan kipan a peangbai a, a vak ngei ngawl mi khat om hi:
Tuapa in Paul thuhilna za hi: Paul in ama sia tangtak in en a, dam natu upna nei hi, ci a heak ciang in,
Na peang tungah a tangtak in ding in, ci in a ngingtak in sawl hi. Taciang tua pa tawn in lampai hi.
Mihon te in Paul i na vawt a mu uh ciang in, amate Lycaonia kam taw, pathian te mihing bang in eite kungah hong tuaksuk uh hi, ci in a ngingtak in au uh hi.
Amate in Barnabas sia, Jupiter, ci uh hi; Paul sia a thuhilpi ahikom in Mercurius, ci uh hi.
Tuazawkciang in a khua mai ah a om Jupiter thiampi in khuital le pakkual te kongpi ah paipui a, mihon te taw biakpiakna piak sawm hi.
Tua thu sawltak te, Paul le Barnabas in a zak uh ciang in, a nik le puan te eau keak uh hi, taciang mihon sungah tai kawm in au uh a,

Banghang in hibang te vawt nu ziam? kote zong note bangma ka hi uh hi, hi a thupi ngawl nate pan in vantung, leitung, tuipi le a sung om theampo a vawt a nungta Pathian sangah kihei tu in note tungah thu ka hil uh hi:
Abosa hun sungah Pathian in minam theampo te amate lampi tek ah paisak hi.
Ahihang Pathian in Ama le Ama sia tetti om ngawl in koithong ngawl a na pha vawt hi, van pan in nguatui le anlak hun te hongpia a, eite i thinsung te an le lungdamna taw hong dimsak hi, ci hi.
Taciang hi thu te hil uh a, mipi te in amate tungah biakpiakna vawt ngawl tu in khak zo vamial uh hi.
Paul Suangtum Taw Deang
Taciang Antioch le Iconiam ah Judah mi pawlkhat te in, mihon te hanthawn uh a, Paul sia suangtum taw a den zawk uh ciang in, thi zo sa uh a, khua puasang ah kaikeak uh hi.
Ahihang nungzui te a kiimkot ah a din tek uh laitak in thoto a, khuasung ah tum hi: taciang a zingciang in Barnabas taw Derbe ah pai uh hi.
Syria Ngam Antioch ah Heakkik
Paul le Barnabas in Derbe khua ah lungdamna thu hil uh a, mi tampi a hil zawk uh ciang in, Lystra, Iconiam le Antioch ah heakkik uh hi.
Nungzui te nuntakna kipsak uh a, upna sungah om paisuak tu le Pathian kumpingam sungah haksatna tampi kantan in i tum hamtang tu hi, ci in hanthawn uh hi.
Taciang amate in pawlpi tatuam ah upa te nasep pia hi, taciang antang in thungetsak a, amate upna Topa tungah ap uh hi.
Taciang amate in Pisidia ngam sung theampo a kantan zawk uh ciang in, Pamphylia theng uh hi.
Perga ah thu a hil zawk uh ciang in, Attalia ah pai uh hi:
Tua mun pan in tembaw taw Antioch sangah pai uh a, Antioch ah amate sepnasa te a seam tu in Pathian i thuthiamna sungah apna a neisakna mun a hihi.
Taciang amate Antioch a thet uh ciang in, pawlpi munkhat ah kaikhawm uh a, Pathian in amate taw a sep uh te Gentile te kungah upna kongkha a honsak na thu te son uh hi.
Tua mun ah a nungzui te taw hun tampi omkhawm uh hi.
